title: Media God Fire TV
message: Fire TV 1.4.19 targets difficult 4K playback. It upgrades the Fire OS-safe Media3 engine to 1.8.0, adds decoder capability checks for real 4K/8K size and frame rate, recognises 10-bit/Main10 and Dolby Vision profiles before playback, routes unsupported UHD formats straight to the compatibility decoder, and works around problematic MKV streams carrying both Dolby Vision and HDR10+ metadata.
